cards.title: Why it works
items: The typed launch contract, exercised: pins carry content, the tune knob carries presence and patch, and the door refuses every missing or unknown binding before any write
The depth seam removes the second rubric seat at LAUNCH time — the run record is the concrete graph, so what you read is what ran
A dispatcher can build the launch brief with no-LLM: required pins listed, tune defaults pre-filled, refusals named together in a single refusal

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes, {{gates}} gate, {{branches}} branch: author -> gate -> twin blind rubrics -> by-patched report
The report seat survives fast-depth removal exactly as the prune law says: a terminal-skipped sibling is not a live dependency
